maintenance_led.reason: Sells medical-surgical, wound care, dental and health software products, mostly new product sales rather than repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are hospitals, dental practices and health systems paid largely by commercial insurers and private payers; government share not majority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own products after the 3M spin-off; Acera and Acutus-type deals are occasional, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Clinical products like Bair Hugger, wound care and health information software are embedded in workflows with regulatory and retraining switching costs.

notes: Mixed businesses (MedSurg, Dental, Health Information Systems, Purification & Filtration); answers reflect the larger medical-surgical part.
